nodes.description: Public token name string of the PalantirCoin contract
Public token symbol string of the PalantirCoin contract
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor
Public uint256 _totalSupply holding the total minted token amount
mapping(address => uint) balances tracking per-account token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed tracking ERC20 allowances
Constructor that sets name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returning balances[tokenOwner]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender to to using safeSub/safeAdd
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens using allowance via safeSub/safeAdd
SafeMath safeSub(uint a, uint b) that requires b <= a before subtracting
SafeMath safeAdd(uint a, uint b) that requires c >= a after adding
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller address used as owner in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) subtraction in transfer relying on external SafeMath
safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom
Raw unchecked uint subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply without SafeMath
Parameter to of transfer(address to, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens (amount) of transfer(address to, uint tokens)
Parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens (amount) of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens (allowance amount) of approve(address spender, uint tokens)

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the string literal "PalantirCoin" to the name state variable
Constructor assigns the string literal "PTIR" to the symbol state variable
Constructor assigns 18 to the decimals state variable
Constructor assigns the initial supply constant to _totalSupply
Constructor uses the untrusted msg.sender as the recipient of the entire initial token supply
Constructor credits the whole supply into balances indexed by the untrusted msg.sender
msg.sender is used directly as the key of the balances mapping during initialization
totalSupply() executes the raw unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply()
balances[address(0)] is the right operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply()
approve() uses the untrusted msg.sender as the allowance owner
approve() writes the requested amount into the allowed mapping
transfer() invokes safeSub on the sender balance and the token amount
msg.sender indexes balances in the safeSub operand of transfer()
The untrusted tokens parameter is the subtrahend passed into safeSub in transfer()
The result of safeSub is stored back into balances[msg.sender] in transfer()
transfer() derives the sender balance key from the untrusted msg.sender
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
The caller-supplied to parameter is used as the key when crediting balances in transfer()
transferFrom() invokes safeSub on balances[from] and on the allowance
The user-supplied from parameter indexes the balance and allowance debited by safeSub
The user-supplied tokens parameter is the amount subtracted in transferFrom()
msg.sender keys the allowance slot allowed[from][msg.sender] debited in transferFrom()
safeSub results are written back to balances[from] and balances[to] in transferFrom()
The safeSub result is written back into allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom()
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
The caller-supplied to parameter is used as the key when crediting balances in transferFrom()
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping for the supplied owner
allowance() reads the allowed mapping for the supplied owner and spender
transfer() delegates its subtraction to the external SafeMath safeSub function
transferFrom() delegates its subtractions to the external SafeMath safeSub function

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only exists to key the balances write inside transfer(), so it should be folded into the transfer function node
The tokens parameter is the user-controlled subtrahend of safeSub in transfer() and should be normalized into that arithmetic operation node
The from parameter is only used to index balances/allowed inside transferFrom() and should be merged into that function node
The destination parameter is only used to credit balances inside transferFrom() and should be merged into that function node
The tokens parameter feeds the debits performed by safeSub in transferFrom() and should be normalized into that unsafe operation node
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance slot key inside approve() and should be merged into that function node
The tokens parameter is only used to set the allowance value inside approve() and should be merged into that function node
